title: Calculation method for vertical federated learning, apparatus, device, and medium

pse.problem: The solution addresses the high security risk associated with keeping a private key by a central node in multi-participant vertical federated learning.
pse.solution_function: The system performs secure two-party joint computation between an upper-layer participation node and multiple lower-layer participation nodes, using homomorphic encryption for forward computation of a submodel. The goal is to obtain outputs of the federated model that can be aggregated to form a joint model output.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of multiple participation nodes arranged in a multi-way tree topology, each node having a locally deployed submodel. Each node also has a public key and (in upper-layer nodes) a first public key that is distributed to lower-layer nodes.
pse.solution_implementation: The secure two-party joint computation involves the upper-layer participation node and a lower-layer participation node working together to perform homomorphic encryption for the submodel using their respective data. The resulting two-party joint outputs are then aggregated by the upper-layer participation node.
pse.effect: By eliminating the need for a central node to keep a private key, this method reduces the security risk concentrated in that node.
